title: NetworkPresence
description: network.presence@1 (plan 2026-10-22 track X item 9): one person's online status as another person may see it. OpenVibe.Network owns presence: POST /api/v1/me/presence/heartbeat keeps it fresh, PUT /api/v1/me/presence sets the chosen state, status line and emoji, and GET /api/v1/presence?subjects=… answers for the people the asker follows or has a DM with. The state is derived: online while the newest heartbeat is under 2 minutes old, away after 10 minutes without input (the client's heartbeat says idle), offline after 3 minutes without a heartbeat. Invisible and show_status off are seen as offline, and an invisible person is left out of the answer entirely; last seen is never returned. live is true while the person is streaming on OpenVibe.Live, and only for someone who would otherwise be visible. (The event is network.presence.changed@1.)

state.description: The public state. A reader never receives invisible (the person is offline instead, or absent from a list); the stored chosen state can be auto, dnd or invisible.

status_text.description: The person's status line in their own words, or null. Never shown while they are invisible or have show_status off.

emoji.description: One emoji that sits beside the status line, or null.

live.description: The person is streaming on OpenVibe.Live now. Live outranks their chosen state; it is false while they are invisible or have show_status off.

updated_at.description: When the person's presence row last changed.
